regime_context: The policy regime is stagflationary split: Warsh's Fed is inflation-mandate first and Warsh is holding the hawkish line while the market now prices >70% odds of a September hike, even as payrolls crack. The administration still wants lower real yields without easing optics, so it suppresses yields structurally via T-bill issuance and holds cuts as inflation-gated optionality. Consensus reads 'coordinated regime'; revealed preference is aligned-incentives with a hawkish near-term Fed that may be forced by labor data to pivot later, not a dovish Fed.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制处于滞胀分裂状态：Warsh 领导下的美联储以通胀目标为先，Warsh 在就业数据走弱的同时仍维持鹰派立场，而市场目前对 9 月加息的定价概率超过 70%。政府仍希望在不释放宽松信号的情况下降低实际收益率，因此通过短期国债发行在结构上压低收益率，并将降息作为以通胀为条件的选举后期权。共识解读为‘协同体制’；但显露出的偏好是激励一致、美联储短期偏鹰，若劳动力数据持续恶化，后续才可能被迫转向，而非美联储主动转鸽。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's Fed is revealed-preference inflation-mandate first: May PCE ran hot while June payrolls cracked, and Warsh still declined to signal any cut while the market moved to >70% probability of a September hike. Until labor weakness overrides the inflation priority, the front end and long end face upward pressure on real yields, and TLT remains at risk versus SPY.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh 领导下的美联储显露出的偏好是通胀目标优先：5 月 PCE 偏热，而 6 月非农走弱，但 Warsh 仍拒绝释放任何降息信号，同时市场对 9 月加息的定价概率升至 70% 以上。在劳动力疲弱压倒通胀优先之前，短端和长端都面临实际收益率上行压力，TLT 相对 SPY 仍面临风险。
evidence: May PCE core +0.3% m/m, 3.4% y/y (highest since Oct-2023); headline +0.4% m/m, 4.1% y/y
June payrolls +57k vs ~115k expected, -74k revisions, participation 61.5%
Warsh Sintra response: 'prices are too high'; declined to signal July
CME FedWatch >70% probability of a Sept hike
theses.dissent: The labor crack is exactly the data the catalyst spine flagged as capable of reopening an easing path; a hard payrolls print could flip front-end pricing and spark a sharp TLT bid.
theses.dissent_zh: 劳动力走弱正是催化剂主线标记为可能重新打开宽松路径的数据；一次疲软的非农数据可能逆转短端定价，并引发 TLT 的急剧买盘。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: TLT 在检查日之前跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: KBE
theses.thesis: Steeper curve and hawkish front-end favor net interest margins and dealer-intermediation reform beneficiaries. Bessent's Treasury is actively reforming dealer intermediation and eSLR, which mechanically improves bank balance-sheet capacity and funding conditions even if the Fed holds or hikes near-term.
theses.thesis_zh: 收益率曲线趋陡和短端偏鹰有利于净息差和交易商中介改革受益者。Bessent 领导的财政部正在积极改革交易商中介和 eSLR，这在美联储短期按兵不动或加息的情况下，仍能机械地改善银行资产负债表容量和融资条件。
evidence: Concrete eSLR-reform progress listed as open prediction
Front-end Treasury proxies BIL/SHV as FACT mechanism
theses.dissent: A hawkish Fed that stays higher-for-longer can compress credit demand and widen deposit betas, squeezing regional bank margins; KBE already missed once in the track record.
theses.dissent_zh: 美联储若维持更长时间的高利率，可能压缩信贷需求并扩大存款 beta，挤压区域银行利润率；KBE 在历史记录中已经错过一次。

falsifier.text: KBE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: KBE 在检查日之前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse and US strikes re-primed the energy rotation; Brent spiked to ~$80 intraday and energy was the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026. The administration's strategic posture tolerates an oil upside shock as part of the stagflationary split, and headline-fragile energy benefits from re-escalation headlines.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火协议破裂和美国空袭重新点燃了能源板块轮动；布伦特原油盘中一度飙升至约 80 美元，能源是 2026 年第一季度 ETF 流入最多的板块。政府的战略姿态容忍石油上行冲击作为滞胀分裂的一部分，而对头条敏感的能源板块受益于冲突升级的新闻。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED (as of 7/8)
Energy was TOP ETF-inflow sector Q1 2026
theses.dissent: A genuine ceasefire or de-escalation would unwind the geopolitical premium quickly; oil is headline-fragile and two-sided.
theses.dissent_zh: 真正的停火或局势降级会迅速消退地缘政治溢价；石油对头条敏感且具有双向性。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: XLE 在检查日之前跑输 SPY 5%

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Hawkish Fed repricing (>70% Sept hike odds) and a rising real yield environment suppress gold's non-yielding bid. Gold is trading $4,044-4,200 range but the revealed policy path is inflation-mandate first with no near-term easing, which is gold-negative relative to SPY unless the labor crack forces a pivot.
theses.thesis_zh: 美联储鹰派重新定价（9 月加息概率超过 70%）和实际收益率上升的环境压制了黄金作为无息资产的买盘。黄金在 4,044 至 4,200 美元区间交易，但显露出的政策路径是通胀目标优先且短期无宽松，除非劳动力走弱迫使转向，否则相对 SPY 黄金偏空。
evidence: CME FedWatch >70% probability of Sept hike
theses.dissent: A Mar-a-Lago Accord tail or a forced dovish pivot on labor weakness would be dollar-bearish and gold-bullish; the track record shows gold underweights have hit but direction accuracy is only 0.375.
theses.dissent_zh: 海湖庄园协议尾部风险或劳动力疲弱迫使的鸽派转向将对美元利空、对黄金利多；历史记录显示黄金低配曾命中，但方向准确率仅为 0.375。

falsifier.text: GLD outperforms SPY by 5% before the check-by date
falsifier.text_zh: GLD 在检查日之前跑赢 SPY 5%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI and HALEU fuel-cycle policy is a structural, targeted rotation; the DOE releasing ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank and AI/critical-infrastructure reactor programs are concrete mechanisms that feed OKLO regardless of the Fed path.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能支持 AI 和 HALEU 燃料循环政策是结构性、定向的轮动；能源部向燃料银行释放至少 20 吨 HALEU 以及 AI/关键基础设施反应堆项目是具体的机制，无论美联储路径如何，都有利于 OKLO。
evidence: Rotation targeted: Nuclear/uranium/HALEU fuel cycle proxies include OKLO
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into fuel bank
Open prediction: AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows contracted/sited project
theses.dissent: SMR and OKLO have been volatile and SMR already missed in track record; policy execution delays or equity dilution could undercut the narrative.
theses.dissent_zh: SMR 和 OKLO 波动较大，SMR 在历史记录中已经错过；政策执行延迟或股权稀释可能削弱这一叙事。
